parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The name of the namespace. Default value: public.

>  You can call the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation to create a namespace and call the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation to query a list of namespaces.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: Rows
parameters.description: The vector data that you want to upload.

sub_parameters.name: Id
sub_parameters.description:
The unique ID of the vector data.

>  If you leave this parameter empty, a unique ID is automatically generated by using uuidgen. If you specify a value that is the same as an existing ID, an updated vector data ID is used.

sub_parameters.name: Metadata
sub_parameters.description: The metadata of the vector data. The key field of this parameter must be the same as the key field of Metadata that is specified when you call the [CreateCollection](~~2401497~~) operation.

sub_parameters.name: Vector
sub_parameters.description: The vector data. The length of the vector data must be the same as the value of Dimension that is specified when you call the [CreateCollection](~~2401497~~) operation.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances. You must specify one of the WorkspaceId and DBInstanceId parameters. If you specify both parameters, the WorkspaceId parameter takes effect.
